_comment: Sandboxed Lab-revamp bench prototype (systems/bench_prototype.gd, .scratch/lab-revamp/spec.md) -- provisional numbers, not production balance, not cross-referenced by REFERENCE.md. rankThresholds[i] is the minimum score for rank i+1. baseCalc is spent per item crafted (a manual run makes one). baseXp is per item, display-only. recipes.*.procedure (Slice A): ideal = the authored perfect procedure (apparatus = data/approaches.json id, target on a 0-100 gauge, weight; weights sum to 100); base = the procedure known at start, its steps' calc summing to baseCalc and spent step by step; baseTolerance = band half-width before skill widening. gauges.heat.risePerSec = needle speed while held. PROSE-REVIEW: every badRun.lines entry is new copy, drafted against CONTENT-GUIDE.md's tone bible.

lines: The mixture sets into something the colour of a bruise. You bin it, and the spoon.
The flask makes a small, polite noise and then a less polite one. The bench will need a new mat.
Whatever this was going to be, it has decided against it.
It smells of burnt hair and Tuesday. You open a window and write nothing down.
The calc goes grey and stays grey. Somewhere, a ledger notes the loss.
